steps.content: You weave through the narrow valley while the monster follows you like a shadow, its eerie howls never ceasing.
Heavy footsteps shake the ground. Pieces of rocks and soil keep falling upon you.

Turning around, you see the monster's massive body squeezing through the valley, rolling toward you. Like a black torrent, it tears down the protruding grass, wood, and stones from the valley walls, engulfing every inch of land in its path as it surges toward you.
In the pitch-black darkness, only those red eyes flicker constantly, always fixated on you two.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This thing sure is a handful.
The monster's steps grow closer. It will catch up eventually. But there's no time to think, and all you can do is run as fast as you can.
